notes.title: Autumn of valor!
notes.content: Enter into the game and take part in the battles from September 23 to October 23 and get a premium account for 7 days.

notes.title: Bots and changes in the game
notes.content:
Bots will participate in all battles from 1 to 5 levels. Bots in battle will be replaced by players who entered the battle.  
For damage done to bots you will receive less silver and experience than if they were players.
For damage taken from bots you will lose less silver than if they were players.
Battle groups:
1. 1-2 lvls
2. 2-3 lvls
3. 3-4 lvls
4. 4-5 lvls
Third level characters now share the second battle group with second levels.
You can invite players to your group again.
Regeneration of stamina has been increased for all characters. (this will help make the game more dynamic).
Damage from mongolian throwing knives(2-5 lvls) has been increased by 40%.

notes.title: Autumn battles
notes.content: Go into the game and take part in the battles from September 20 to October 5 and get a premium account for 10 days.

notes.title: Arena update
notes.content:
Now you can find in the game "Weekly Arena" and "Tasks".
Weekly arena - here you can get rewards depending on your rank for the week. It can be gold, silver, experience and manor resourses. 
Than more points you have, than more likely to get better rewards.
How can you get these points?
Win=100 points
Kill= 10 points
100 damage= 3 points
Tasks - you have some tasks every day for which you will receive rewards.
